title: No MCP server — the central deliverable is stubbed as an interactive CLI
evidence: main.go:77-79 Listen() comment 'In a real implementation, this would start listening for MCP requests. For now, we'll provide a simple CLI interface for testing' then calls s.runCLI(); Request/Response/Error/Notification structs (main.go:19-44) are declared but never instantiated (grep for 'Request{|Response{|Notification{|RegisterTool|jsonrpc|tools/list|tools/call' across *.go returns nothing); no os.Stdin/bufio/json.Decode JSON-RPC loop exists
suggestion: Implement a real MCP server: a JSON-RPC stdio loop that handles initialize/tools/list/tools/call and registers the query functions as MCP tools

title: No head-to-head record between two named teams
evidence: data.go exposes FindMatchesByTeam(one team, data.go:498) and GetTeamStats(one team, data.go:533) only; no function takes two team names and returns H2H W/L/D. Spec asks for it explicitly (TASK.md:189 'Compare Palmeiras and Santos head-to-head', TASK.md:253 'Head-to-head records', TASK.md:334 'Can compare teams head-to-head', example output TASK.md:175). grep for 'HeadToHead|H2H|Versus' across *.go returns nothing
suggestion: Add a function taking two team names, filter matches where both appear, and tally W/L/D from each side's perspective

title: Season filtering exists only inside aggregates; no date-range filter and no season-filtered match listing
evidence: GetTeamStats (data.go:541) and GetBrasileiraoStandings (data.go:595) apply 'if m.Season != season continue', but FindMatchesByTeam (data.go:498) has no season or date-range parameter, and no query returns a match list filtered by season or date range
suggestion: Add season/date-range parameters to the match-listing query so matches can be filtered directly

title: Competition is captured but not a selectable filter on match queries
evidence: Match.Competition is populated per source file (data.go:118,169,218) and standings hardcode-filter Competition=='Brasileirão' (data.go:598), but there is no user-selectable competition filter — FindMatchesByTeam returns matches across all competitions with no way to query e.g. only Libertadores matches
suggestion: Expose a competition parameter on the match-query path so results can be scoped to Brasileirão / Copa do Brasil / Libertadores

title: Four tests use t.Skipf conditional on data-load failure
evidence: main_test.go:64,88,110,131 call t.Skipf if the CSV fails to load; they did not fire this run (test_coverage=0.675 > 0, tests executed) but would silently pass-by-skip if the dataset were absent
suggestion: Fail hard (t.Fatalf) on load errors in tests that depend on the fixture data, or bundle a small deterministic fixture
